items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I played with guys like Bill... Bill Douglas, played bass... We were working a joint in the Bronx. Curly Russell came over and looked at me on the stand with Bill. There was two of us playing this little joint.

ctx.x: "We were rough and ready guys,/But oh, how we could harmonize./Heart of my heart..." And Bill's just hitting the same note, and just looking at his partner, proud like he's just... You know, like he's playing the right notes. He ain't playing nothin'. And he told me, he says, "You sound great, Danny. I ain't playin' nothin'" Some nights I got... "Man, I'm disgusted. Don't come get me
